name: csv-grid-editor-plus
displayName: CSV Grid Editor Plus: CSV & TSV Viewer
description: Open, view and edit CSV and TSV files in a fast sortable filterable grid. Inline editing, find and replace, freeze rows, column stats, Excel copy and paste and export to JSON. Free.

commands.title: Set Large File Mode (head / tail / all)
Accelerate Repeated Opening (Build Byte Offset Index)

enumDescriptions: Ask every time: show a picker when opening a file larger than 10 MB (original behavior).
Head: preview the first csvGridEditor.headRows rows of large files.
Tail: preview the last csvGridEditor.headRows rows of large files.
All: always load the full file into the grid (may be slow for very large files).
csvGridEditor.largeFileMode.description: Behavior when opening CSV files larger than 10MB.

csvGridEditor.headRows.description: Number of rows to display in head/tail preview mode.

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.enabled.description: Enable the optional byte-offset index cache (.csvidx) for repeated opening of large files. Index files are stored in the extension's global storage, never next to your CSVs.

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.autoGenera.description: Automatically build the index in the background once the same file has been opened openThreshold times. First opens always use pure streaming with zero extra disk writes.

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.openThresh.description: Number of times the same file must be opened before its byte-offset index is built automatically.

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.allowManua.description: Allow building/rebuilding the index manually via the 'Accelerate Repeated Opening' command.

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of cached index files kept (LRU eviction beyond this).

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.maxAgeDays.description: Indexes not used for this many days are deleted automatically.

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.autoClean.description: Automatically prune the index cache on startup and after builds (LRU + max age).

csvGridEditor.byteOffsetIndex.verifyFing.description: Additionally verify a content fingerprint (sha1 of size + first/last 64KB) before reusing an index, catching same-size same-mtime edits.

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && npm run copy-assets && npm run bundle
